output:
I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

The last call was cut off before it ran, so I'm reissuing it as separate file writes.

Now a full test run in a clean copy: a default build, then the variants.

The installed headers landed in `include/` instead of `include/isodur/`. I'm fixing that in the top-level `Makefile.am`.

Next I'm checking the installed tree, using a consumer program built against the installed library with `pkg-config`.

To finish, I'm running a build with a different `VERSION` and interface version, plus an in-tree build.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md` in every configuration I tried. The one thing that fails is `make check` with a changed `VERSION`, because `tests/cases/version.out` hard-codes `1.4.0` and I can't edit it.

I ran each configuration from a clean copy of `/app` in `/tmp`, after `autoreconf -fi`:

- **Default build:** `make check` passes 2 of 2. The install lists the right files, including `libisodur.so.2.1.0` with SONAME `libisodur.so.2`. `durfmt` is a relative link to `isodur`, and `make uninstall DESTDIR` leaves no files behind.
- **`--disable-shared`:** passes 2 of 2 and installs only `libisodur.a`.
- **`--disable-tool`:** passes 1 of 1 (`unit` only) and installs no `isodur` or `durfmt`.
- **`--libdir=.../lib64` with another `--datarootdir`:** passes 2 of 2. After a real install, `isodur` and `durfmt` run with no environment variables and find `units.tsv` in the new data directory.
- **Consumers:** programs built with pkg-config link and run, shared and static. The pkg-config file has the right `pkgdatadir`, and the shared library exports only `isodur_*` symbols.
- **`make distcheck`:** passes. The unpacked tarball rebuilds after `autoreconf -fi` and its checks pass.
- **`VERSION` 2.5.1 with interface `7:2:3`:** the install has `libisodur.so.4.3.2`, `isodur --version` says 2.5.1 and `Version: 2.5.1` is in `isodur.pc`. This build's `make check` fails 1 of 2 because of the hard-coded `1.4.0` in `version.out`.
- **In-tree build:** also passes with the default `VERSION`.
- **Not run:** I didn't run `make distcheck` on a build with a changed `VERSION`. The distcheck I tried on the changed-`VERSION` tree failed in `make check` for the same `version.out` reason.

What I changed:

- **`configure.ac`:**
  - `AC_INIT` now reads `VERSION`.
  - The tool conditional works with `--disable-tool`.
  - `data/Makefile` is now generated.
  - The `ISODUR_DATADIR` define is removed. The unexpanded `$datadir/isodur` was wrong.
- **`Makefile.am`:**
  - Headers install under `include/isodur/`.
  - The pkg-config file goes in `$(libdir)/pkgconfig`.
  - `VERSION`, `version.h.in` and `isodur.pc.in` are added to the tarball.
  - A change to `VERSION` makes configure regenerate.
- **`lib/Makefile.am`:** `-version-info $(ISODUR_LT_VERSION)`, `-export-symbols-regex`, the math library linked in, `internal.h` distributed, and include paths that work in a VPATH build.
- **`src/Makefile.am`:** the data directory is compiled in as `$(pkgdatadir)`. The `durfmt` link honours `DESTDIR` and `uninstall` removes it.
- **`data/Makefile.am`:** `units.tsv` is added to the tarball.
- **`tests/Makefile.am`:** `cli.test` runs only when the tool is built, with absolute paths for VPATH. Every case file is listed for the tarball.
- **`isodur.pc.in`:** all paths come from configure, and `Libs.private` names the math library.
- **`m4/README`:** added so `m4/` exists before `autoreconf` runs.

`/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

command_result.command: cd /app && git status 2>&1 | head -3; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/BUILDING.md; cat VERSION configure.ac; cat Makefile.am; cat isodur.pc.in

cd /app && for f in lib/Makefile.am src/Makefile.am data/Makefile.am tests/Makefile.am tests/cli.test include/isodur/version.h.in CHANGELOG.md docs/consuming.md docs/isodur.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; grep -n 'ISODUR_DATADIR\|include\|config.h\|VERSION' src/main.c lib/*.c lib/internal.h tests/unit.c | head -60; ls -a; ls m4

cd /app && cat lib/internal.h include/isodur/isodur.h; grep -n 'isodur__\|lround\|ISODUR_VERSION\|config.h' -r lib include src | head -50; sed -n 1,40p src/main.c; autoconf --version|head -1; automake --version|head -1; libtool --version|head -1
cd /app && sed -n 40,260p src/main.c; which libtoolize pkg-config pkgconf

cd /app/tests && python3 - <<'E'
import os
fs=sorted(os.listdir('cases'))
s=open('Makefile.am').read()
s=s.replace('EXTRA_DIST = cli.test $(CASE_FILES)\nCASE_FILES = $(wildcard $(srcdir)/cases/*)\n','EXTRA_DIST = cli.test \\\n'+' \\\n'.join('\tcases/'+f for f in fs)+'\n')
open('Makefile.am','w').write(s)
E
tail -25 Makefile.am
rm -rf /tmp/t && cp -r /app /tmp/t/ 2>/dev/null || (mkdir /tmp/t && cp -r /app/. /tmp/t/src0 ) ; ls /tmp/t | head; cd /tmp/t && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | tail -20; ls

mkdir -p /app/m4 && echo 'Project macros; libtoolize copies its own here.' > /app/m4/README; cat > /tmp/run.sh <<'E'
# usage: run.sh name configure-args...
set -e
n=$1; shift
rm -rf /tmp/w/$n; mkdir -p /tmp/w/$n; cp -r /app /tmp/w/$n/src; cd /tmp/w/$n/src; autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1
mkdir ../b; cd ../b
../src/configure --prefix=/tmp/w/$n/pfx "$@" >cfg.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 cfg.log; exit 1; }
make >mk.log 2>&1 || { tail -30 mk.log; exit 1; }
make check >chk.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 chk.log; cat tests/*.log | tail -30; exit 1; }
grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL|TOTAL)' chk.log
make install DESTDIR=/tmp/w/$n/stage >inst.log 2>&1 || { tail inst.log; exit 1; }
(cd /tmp/w/$n/stage && find . | sort)
E
bash /tmp/run.sh a 2>&1 | tail -50

bash /tmp/run.sh a 2>&1 | grep -v '^\./tmp/w/a/pfx/\(share\|lib/lib\)'; cd /tmp/w/a/b && make uninstall DESTDIR=/tmp/w/a/stage >/dev/null 2>&1; find /tmp/w/a/stage -not -type d; echo ---; cat /tmp/w/a/pfx/lib/pkgconfig/isodur.pc 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/w/a/b/isodur.pc; ls -l /tmp/w/a/b/src/

cd /tmp; bash run.sh s --disable-shared 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|lib/|rror'; bash run.sh t --disable-tool 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|bin|rror|TOTAL'; bash run.sh l --libdir=/tmp/w/l/pfx/lib64 --datarootdir=/tmp/w/l/pfx/dat 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|lib|rror|dat'
cd /tmp; for n in l s; do echo "== $n"; bash cons.sh $n 2>&1; done

cd /tmp/w/a/b && make distcheck 2>&1 | tail -8; ls *.tar.gz; mkdir -p /tmp/w/tb && cd /tmp/w/tb && rm -rf * && tar xzf /tmp/w/a/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz && cd isodur-1.4.0 && tar tzf /tmp/w/a/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -c cases/; autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir b && cd b && ../configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'
cd /tmp/w/a/b && tar tzf isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -v cases/; ls -la /app/data; cat /app/data/Makefile.am

cd /app/data && printf 'pkgdata_DATA = units.tsv\nEXTRA_DIST = units.tsv\n' > Makefile.am; rm -rf /tmp/w/a; bash /tmp/run.sh a >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /tmp/w/a/b && make distcheck 2>&1 | tail -4; mkdir -p /tmp/w/tb && cd /tmp/w/tb && rm -rf * && tar xzf /tmp/w/a/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz && cd isodur-1.4.0 && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir b && cd b && ../configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'
cd /tmp/w/v/b && grep -B2 -A8 FAIL tests/cli.test.log | head -20; cat /app/tests/cases/version.out

cd /app && ls -a . m4; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Repaired configure.ac (VERSION in AC_INIT, BUILD_TOOL conditional, data/Makefile config), the Makefile.am files (version-info from ISODUR_LT_VERSION, export regex, LIBM, VPATH include paths, pkgdatadir define from make, durfmt link with DESTDIR and uninstall, header subdir, pkgconfigdir, dist contents, cli test wiring) and isodur.pc.in. Verified default, --disable-shared, lib64+datarootdir, --disable-tool, distcheck, tarball rebuild and a changed VERSION/interface; with another VERSION the fixed tests/cases/version.out (1.4.0) naturally fails."}' > STATUS.json; python3 -m json.tool STATUS.json >/dev/null && echo ok
